### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing genomeassembler output: one directory per sample (and per read group) with assembly/, polish/, scaffold/, QC/ and reads/, plus pipeline_info/. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The samplesheet the run was started with (the pipeline publishes no copy of it). Defaults to input/samplesheet.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Samplesheet column holding the sample name every output directory is named after. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Samplesheet column the design filters and colours group on (strategy, assembler, polish, group or any column you added). |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Display label for GROUP_COL in titles. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`busco/batch_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/busco/batch_summary.py) | One row per assessed assembly, from BUSCO's `batch_summary.txt`. | `assembly_id`, `input_file`, `lineage`, `complete_pct`, `single_pct`, `duplicated_pct`, `fragmented_pct`, `missing_pct`, `n_markers`, `stop_codon_pct`, `scaffold_n50`, `contig_n50`, `percent_gaps`, `n_scaffolds` |
| [`busco/composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/busco/composition.py) | BUSCO scores as four classes per assembly, for a composition bar. | `assembly_id`, `lineage`, `busco_class`, `rank`, `class_order`, `percent` |
| [`genomescope/summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/genomescope/summary.py) | One row per read set, from GenomeScope's summary table. | `read_set`, `genomescope_version`, `k`, `ploidy`, `heterozygosity_min`, `heterozygosity_max`, `haploid_length_min`, `haploid_length_max`, `repeat_length_min`, `repeat_length_max`, `unique_length_min`, `unique_length_max`, `repeat_fraction`, `model_fit_min`, `model_fit_max`, `read_error_rate_min`, `read_error_rate_max` |
| [`jellyfish/histogram.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/jellyfish/histogram.py) | The read k-mer spectrum of each read set, from `jellyfish histo` output. | `read_set`, `multiplicity`, `kmers`, `kmer_mass`, `peak_multiplicity` |
| [`merqury/assembly_qv.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/merqury/assembly_qv.py) | One row per assembly: Merqury's QV joined to its k-mer completeness. | `assembly_id`, `merqury_name`, `asm_only_kmers`, `total_kmers`, `qv`, `error_rate`, `solid_kmers_assembly`, `solid_kmers_reads`, `kmer_completeness` |
| [`merqury/copy_number_composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/merqury/copy_number_composition.py) | Share of solid read k-mers by copy number in the assembly, per assembly. | `assembly_id`, `copy_class`, `rank`, `class_order`, `solid_kmers`, `percent`, `error_cutoff` |
| [`merqury/sequence_qv.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/merqury/sequence_qv.py) | One row per assembled sequence, from Merqury's per-sequence QV files. | `assembly_id`, `sequence`, `asm_only_kmers`, `total_kmers`, `qv`, `error_rate`, `error_free` |
| [`nf-core/genomeassembler/assemblies.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/genomeassembler/recipes/assemblies.py) | One row per assessed assembly: every QC tool of nf-core/genomeassembler, joined. | `assembly_id`, `sample`, `stage`, `stage_class`, `stage_rank`, `assembler_used`, `scaffolders`, `n_sequences`, `total_length`, `largest_sequence`, `n50`, `l50`, `n90`, `l90`, `aun`, `qv`, `error_rate`, `kmer_completeness`, `busco_lineage`, `busco_complete`, `busco_single`, `busco_duplicated`, `busco_fragmented`, `busco_missing`, `genome_fraction`, `misassemblies`, `mismatches_per_100kbp`, `nga50`, `qc_tools`, `n_qc_tools` |
| [`nf-core/genomeassembler/nx_curve.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/genomeassembler/recipes/nx_curve.py) | Nx curve of every assessed assembly, from the lengths `samtools idxstats` lists. | `assembly_id`, `sample`, `stage`, `nx`, `sequence_length`, `n_sequences`, `total_length` |
